notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Roaring Blades has at least two indestructible counters on it.
Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
description:
Activate Myojin of Roaring Blades by removing an indestructible counter from it, dealing 7 damage to Park Heights Maverick and any two other targets.
Park Heights Maverick dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness, triggering its ability, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Roaring Blades and Myojin of Grim Betrayal.
Activate Myojin of Grim Betrayal by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting Park Heights Maverick from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
